    snapops,
    maintcost,

    CAST(regexp_replace(revloss, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS numeric) as revloss_numeric,
    ROUND(CAST(maintcost AS numeric) / CAST(regexp_replace(revloss, '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS numeric), 4) as cost_to_revenue_ratio
FROM operational_metrics 
WHERE snapops = 'PV937101'
